# The Parallax

> A free daily newsletter that shows how the same news stories are covered across the political spectrum.

The Parallax aggregates news from 15 sources across left, right, and center perspectives, then uses AI to cluster related stories and show how different outlets frame the same events.

## Key Facts

- Free daily email newsletter
- 15 news sources across the political spectrum
- AI-powered story clustering and synthesis
- Every story includes both left-leaning and right-leaning coverage
- Founded in Pittsburgh, PA
- Subscribe at: https://www.readparallax.com

## Sources

Left-leaning: NPR, The Guardian, Washington Post, Vox
Center: BBC, Axios, Bloomberg, MarketWatch, Al Jazeera
Right-leaning: Fox News, Daily Wire, NY Post, Washington Examiner, Newsmax, Zero Hedge
